decisions.reason: A classic lever handle line close to the core range costs little to keep in the catalogue, and architectural hardware lifecycles run many years, so withdrawal after four years is unlikely.
A multi-model handle family supports the firm's system breadth across project budgets and is typically kept for a decade or more.
This single design is somewhat more exposed to catalogue streamlining, as Product C's withdrawal showed, but having survived to 2022 it likely has project traction and costs little to maintain.
A handle family with several models adds design breadth across budget levels and is likely to stay in the range.
The flagship electronic access system is central to the firm's digital building organisation strategy; it would more likely be updated than withdrawn.
